in_text_mentions: A six-month-old female presented with progressively increasing mass at the nasal bridge, occluding the eyes and nose with increasing difficulty in breathing. Mother had full antenatal clinic and was on folic acid. Clinical examination showed a multilobed non-tender cystic mass originating from the nasal bridge and overlying the face. The OFC was 45 cm. Brain MRI showed features in keeping with frontoethmoidal meningo-encephalocele (Figure 5). She had surgical excision and repair of frontoethmoidal encephalocele with reasonably good outcome and milestones at six months (Figure 6).
